notes: Panel Settings now uses the same controls as the Control Panel. The previous version re-implemented its own inputs, dropdowns, switches and buttons instead of using the ones the design system already provides, so it looked nothing like the…

Font, colour and content-amount choices are visible again. They had been marked as requiring a paid plan - an assumption that was never a product decision - which hid the very settings that were asked for. Nothing is plan-gated now.
Removed the theme picker from Panel Settings. It does not belong on this surface.
The panel name shown is the one from the panel list rather than a separate copy kept by the settings window.
